headline: first measured case in this project where a GUI fault was localised correctly from environment outcomes alone, with no oracle and no model

environment.grading_source: read from the task page: click handler checks document.querySelector('#ch'+correctElement.index).checked and calls core.endEpisode(r, r>0)
environment.note: the grader was READ, not inferred. It checks the radio with the generated index.

the_bug_that_produced_three_false_zeros.symptom: 0/10, then 0/12, then 0/4, then 1/10, then 2/10 success while clicking the label-correct option
the_bug_that_produced_three_false_zeros.root_cause: the Submit button was clicked at a hard-coded y coordinate. The task draws between 2 and 6 options (core.randi(2,7)), each pushing Submit down. Submit sits at y=132 for 3 options and y=186 for 6. The fixed click landed on empty space whenever the list was long.
the_bug_that_produced_three_false_zeros.fix: read #subbtn.getBoundingClientRect() live, after the option click and layout change, then click its centre
the_bug_that_produced_three_false_zeros.why_it_matters: four separate times this round a zero looked like a capability limit and was an addressing error. The rule 'never report a first zero without auditing the instrument' earned its place again.

the_controlled_experiment.design: 12 runs. Every run took exactly {start, one option click, submit}. On runs where k%2==1 the option clicked was the neighbour of the goal-named one; otherwise it was the goal-named one. Nothing else varied.
the_controlled_experiment.injected_defect: click the neighbouring option instead of the goal-named one

conditions_under_which_this_worked: the action that caused the failure was under the policy's control and varied across runs
the causal action never co-occurred with success (0/6)
the action vocabulary was identical in every run
both Ochiai and the outcome-contrast statistic named the same action
what_this_does_NOT_establish: that the method works on real software GUIs, where the cause is not under the agent's control and does not vary by construction
that the 26/130 reach number changed -- this round did not re-measure it
that a general agent can be built on this: the experiment injected the defect, which a real failure does not do
any localisation accuracy rate: n=12, one task, one defect class
honest_reading: this is an existence proof that the GUI can supply a localisation signal through repeated execution, which is what Famas claimed and what this project's earlier 'no coverage spectrum' conclusion denied. It is NOT a capability number.
